79: Three things decide it: whether the pile springs back, whether the backing still holds together, and whether the color still works for you. All three yes, and a $99-per-room stretch is the whole fix. Any no — traffic lanes packed flat, seams pulling apart, backing crumbling, pet odor that outlasted professional cleaning — and it's replacement. Stairs usually go first in the two-story subdivisions. We look and tell you plainly which one you've got.
83: Dogs come in off wet pasture and shop floors, so the pad matters as much as the carpet. A moisture-barrier pad stops accidents before they reach the subfloor, and soak-through into the subfloor is what makes odor permanent. Over it goes solution-dyed nylon with a sealed backing — the color runs through the fiber, so even diluted bleach won't fade it. The barrier pad runs $0.65 per square foot and up.
85: Two warranties end up on your written quote. The mill's runs 10 to 25 years against wear and stains, depending on the grade you pick; OC Flooring's is a 1-year workmanship warranty on the installation itself. One thing to know before choosing a pad: mills can void coverage below a minimum pad grade, which is why all three grades ride out to Monroe with the samples and we match the pad to the warranty.
